findings.title: No authentication on any API endpoint
findings.description: All P8 endpoints were unauthenticated; any client could create, modify, or disable targets.
findings.resolution: require_permission() dependency added to all mutating endpoints. 401/403 enforced.

findings.title: No CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints
findings.description: POST/PATCH/DELETE endpoints had no CSRF protection.
findings.resolution: Per-session CSRF token using HMAC-SHA256. X-CSRF-Token header required for all mutating endpoints.

findings.title: No session management — stateless JWT risk / localStorage exposure
findings.description: No session system existed. Risk of XSS-based token theft if JWT stored in localStorage.
findings.resolution: Opaque server-side session with HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie. No token in localStorage.

findings.title: No rate limiting on login endpoint
findings.description: Login endpoint had no brute-force protection.
findings.resolution: LoginRateLimiter: 5 attempts per 15 minutes per (username, IP). Returns retry-after on lockout.

findings.title: No security headers on HTTP responses
findings.resolution: SecurityHeadersMiddleware added as outermost middleware in app.py.

findings.title: CORS allows all origins
findings.description: CORSMiddleware used config.cors.allowed_origins which defaulted to ['*'] in development.
findings.resolution: CORS origins now sourced from SecurityConfig.allowed_origins (SENTINEL_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env). Explicit allow_headers list including X-CSRF-Token.

findings.title: WebSocket endpoints had no authentication
findings.description: Any unauthenticated client could subscribe to real-time alert and sighting events.
findings.resolution: WS handshake reads sentinel_session cookie. 4401 on missing/invalid session. Topic-level permission enforcement with 4403.

findings.title: Audit log placeholder never wrote real events
findings.resolution: Replaced with real AuditLogger calls in all routers. Fail_closed mode for critical operations.

findings.title: No user management capability
findings.description: No API to create operators or provision the initial admin.
findings.resolution: Full CRUD user management API at /api/v1/users (ADMIN-only). CLI bootstrap_admin for first-run.

findings.title: Frontend had no auth state or route guards
findings.description: Dashboard accessible without authentication; no login page.
findings.resolution: AuthContext provider with session detection. LoginPage. ProtectedRoute guard with 401->login redirect and 403->AccessDenied display.
